data.name: Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail
data.detailed_description:
🗡️ Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail

Step into the world of Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail, a single-player parkour adventure inspired by history, mystery, and legend.

When Amir Temur’s legendary sword is stolen, you are pulled into a brutal and unforgiving journey to reclaim it and restore honor to your homeland.

Run, climb, and leap across ancient castles, forgotten ruins, and deadly landscapes where one mistake can cost you everything. Hidden blades, collapsing floors, sudden traps, and merciless terrain are designed to push your patience to the limit and test your true skill.

This is not just a game — it’s a challenge. Every step you take, every jump you make, and every trap you survive is a battle against the environment itself.

Solve  puzzles, and interact with a living world that reacts to your every move. Master precision timing, risky parkour routes, stealth segments, and heart-pounding escapes woven into a powerful story of heritage and destiny.

This game is built entirely by a single Uzbek developer — combining insane dedication, creativity, and cinematic vision into one intense, unforgettable experience.

⚔️ Key Features

• Parkour and climbing mechanics inspired by Uncharted 
• Immersive sound design with dynamic footstep audio, echo effects, and environmental ambience
• Ruthless traps and precision-based platforming that reward only the most patient and skilled players
• Puzzles 
• Storytelling

Only the brave can follow the sword’s trail. The rest will fall. 🗡️

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: none
